berichten.titel: Cell-cultured pork biomass as an emerging food ingredient: Physicochemical properties and heat-induced structuring under low-salt conditions
berichten.samenvatting: With the rapid development of cellular agriculture, cell-cultured pork biomass (CCPB) has emerged as a promising animal-derived material for next-generation meat products. However, its physicochemical properties, colloidal behavior, and structure-forming mechanisms remain poorly understood, limiting its rational application in food design. This study evaluated the dispersibility, ion-responsive behavior, and heat-induced gelation of CCPB under low-salt conditions, using ovalbumin (OVA), whey protein isolate (WPI), and myofibrillar protein (MP) as reference systems.
